# Images

Static image assets for Digtech Academy.

## Structure

- `logo.svg` — main logo (moved from `public/`)
- `logo-light.svg` — light variant for dark backgrounds (moved from `public/`)
- `icon.svg` — favicon / app icon (moved from `public/`)
- `og-image.png` — social sharing preview (1200×630, add when ready)
- `hero-bg.jpg` — hero section background (add when ready)

Course thumbnails, tutor photos, and certificates are stored in Supabase Storage buckets
(`course-thumbnails`, `tutor-documents`, `certificates`) — not here.
